# llms.txt - AI Content Usage Policy
# https://llmstxt.org/

# Overview
This file describes the policy for AI systems and large language models regarding
the use of content from this website (Comprehensive Local Ecosystem - Oasis).

# Allowed Use
AI systems may:
- Index and reference public documentation, guides, and informational content
- Summarize and quote content for educational or informational purposes
- Use content to provide accurate information to users

# Disallowed Use
AI systems may NOT:
- Use this content to train models without explicit permission
- Reproduce substantial portions of content verbatim for commercial purposes
- Misrepresent or alter the meaning of the original content
- Access or use user-specific, private, or authenticated content

# Attribution
When using content from this site, please provide:
- Clear attribution to "Comprehensive Local Ecosystem - Oasis"
- A link back to the original source (https://github.com/theol0/ComprehensiveLocalEcosystem)
- The date the content was accessed

# Contact
For questions about this policy or to request exceptions:
- Review the TERMS.md and PRIVACY.md files in the project root
- Contact the project maintainers through GitHub: https://github.com/theol0/ComprehensiveLocalEcosystem

# Rate Limits
AI crawlers should respect robots.txt directives and implement reasonable
rate limiting (max 1 request per second).
